acceptance: A candidate whose core_sha is an ancestor of the deployed core_sha ends without a failed conclusion, logs a notice naming both SHAs, and posts nothing to issue #58
A candidate that has diverged from the deployed core_sha still fails closed and is reported as today
Tests cover the behind and diverged cases
context: Found 2026-10-31 while classifying failed production deploy runs; see deploy-resolver-reads-every-deployment-20261031 for the other classes.
description: A core-bundle repository_dispatch that waits in the runner queue can start after a newer core commit is already live. The deploy then refuses it with 'candidate core_sha is behind relative to the deployed core_sha <sha>; refusing an older or diverged bundle'. Refusing is correct, but the run fails, the failure is classed 'infrastructure' by the default at .github/workflows/deploy.yml:254, and a comment is posted on issue #58. Runs 41130311775, 41139487358 and 41161657057 (2026-10-30/31). The org stays on the GitHub Free 20-job cap with 15-40 minute queue waits under load, so these false failures will keep recurring and hide real failures in #58.
